answer: Give every identity a distinct economic footprint: to earn, it must show small non-refundable fees paid to independent merchants outside its own cluster, each marked with an unforgable pigment of origin. The network audits the payment graph for cycles — money merely circulating among an attacker's own fakes, like a tide returning to the same shore, scores zero. An orchard grows only from seeds planted in different soils; only identities whose spending reaches genuinely separate counterparties gain standing. A sybil farmer must pay real outsiders for every fake, while an honest agent pays once.
